Rae (People Ops): Quick sync — Diego Torres starts Mon 10/10. Need on-site I-9, BG final check, laptop hold, benefits enrollment, and badge/photo. Who can cover reception handoff?
Nisha (Hiring): I'll meet him at reception 08:45. He said he'll bring passport + driver's license (originals) — should be fine.
Rae (People Ops): Perfect. If he forgets passport we can offer a remote I-9 verifier slot at 14:30 same day. Mark HRIS 'I-9: remote' if we go that route.
Oliver (IT): Imaging reserved 09:00-09:20. MacBook Pro 14" reserved and labelled "Diego T". I'll leave USB-C adapter & sleeve at reception. MDM auto-enroll on first boot.
security-bot: Policy reminder: permanent badge issuance requires background check green. Temp badge OK for orientation only. BG link sent to diego.t@personal.email — status: pending consent.
payroll-bot: Heads-up: W-4 + direct deposit must be completed before Fri payroll cutoff 17:00 to avoid manual exception. Benefits enrollment window opens Day 1.
Nisha (Hiring): Can we schedule a short benefits walkthrough at 10:30 in Conf C? 20 mins should do.
Rae (People Ops): Yes — I'll book Conf C and include the benefits packet link in the day-1 email. Also opening a badge expedite ticket in case BG clears late.
Oliver (IT): If Diego needs remote onboarding, I can host a 16:00 MDM/SSO Zoom helper and issue temporary creds that expire in 24h. Remote I-9 rules apply (show originals on camera + submit scans within 3 business days).
Rae (People Ops): Action items: 1) Nisha meet reception 08:45 2) Oliver imaging & laptop at reception 09:00 3) Security watch BG and issue temp badge if needed 4) Payroll ensure W-4/DD reminder 5) People Ops send day-1 checklist + kiosk map. Welcome Diego! :tada:
